title: Helical compression spring

checks.why: one continuous wire, not five rings
coil 40 across plus the wire, and 5 pitches plus the wire tall
a real helix is longer than 5 flat rings of the same radius
centred on the axis, half way up
the wire is a swept surface — stacked rings are cylinders only
a helix has two flat ends; a stack of N rings has 2N
